what_i_got_wrong: I DUPLICATED ANOTHER SESSION'S WORK AND ONLY THE PUSH TOLD ME. I regenerated the manifest against a clean tree at 978aa89 and committed it; while that commit was being gated (a 287 s manuscripts suite), a concurrent session landed the identical hand-repair as 5cf6e05. My push was rejected, the rebase conflicted on that exact file, and I aborted and dropped my commit rather than rebasing it -- the trunk was already green. AUT-PD-117's own text warned against regenerating the manifest by hand in a dev sandbox for precisely this reason (AUT-PD-028), and I did it anyway because the trunk was red and the repair was two lines. The lease protects a LEDGER ROW; it does not protect a FILE, and two cycles can hold different rows whose work lands in the same artifact.
